english.title: Procure inclusion of tobacco advertisement in information society service
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..) procured the inclusion of a tobacco advertisement in an information society service by means of which, provided in the course of a business, it had been published in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3A(2)(b) and 16(2) of the Tobacco Advertising and Promotion Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
where by means of an information society service
provided in the course of a business
a tobacco advertisement was published
in the United Kingdom
a person who directly / indirectly procured the inclusion of the tobacco advertisement in the information society service is guilty of an offence

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
